Compile a frozen-provenance, on-demand metric schedule

Source: R/metric-learning.R
compile_metric_schedule.Rd

Compilation binds a metric recipe to canonical residual sufficient statistics, spatial supports, and evaluation edges. What is frozen is the estimator identity, training assignment, source revisions, and regularization policy. Local covariance and precision matrices are derived when requested and are never retained as a node-by-fold table.

Usage

compile_metric_schedule(
  recipe,
  statistics,
  at,
  over,
  training = metric_training_policy("exclude_evaluation")
)

Arguments

recipe

A recipe from identity_metric(), diagonal_precision(), or shrinkage_precision().

statistics

Canonical residual_pair_statistics().

at

The same support-index-backed frame used to accumulate statistics.

over

An evaluation pairing().

training

A metric_training_policy().

Value

An effect_frozen_metric_schedule.
